foods.name: Samosa
foods.healthier_alternative: Air-fried or baked sweet potato & pea samosa with mint-coriander chutney instead of sweet tamarind sugar syrup.
foods.reason: Deep frying in refined oil and refined flour (maida) severely aggravates Pitta (acidity) and Kapha (sluggish digestion), while creating Ama (metabolic toxins).

foods.name: Chole Bhature
foods.healthier_alternative: Chole with whole wheat tandoori roti or roasted multigrain kulcha with soaked chickpeas cooked with cumin, ajwain and hing.
foods.reason: Fermented maida fried in oil combined with dense chickpeas taxes Mandagni (weak digestive fire) leading to bloating and sluggishness.

foods.name: Khichdi
foods.healthier_alternative: Already the gold standard of Ayurvedic food! Add 1 tsp A2 cow ghee and tempered cumin for peak digestion.
foods.reason: Yellow split moong dal and aged rice cooked with turmeric, cumin, and rock salt is universally balancing, easily assimilable, and cleanses the gut.

foods.name: Paratha
foods.healthier_alternative: Methi (fenugreek) or palak paratha roasted with minimal pure ghee on an iron tawa rather than swimming in refined oil.
foods.reason: Adding bitter greens like methi cuts the heavy Kapha nature of wheat, and roasted ghee digests much cleaner than burned seed oils.

foods.name: Idli Sambar
foods.healthier_alternative: Ragi or oats idli with freshly made vegetable-rich sambar; reduce red chilies and tamarind to keep Pitta calm.
foods.reason: Steam cooking makes idli extremely gentle on Agni. Sambar provides protein from toor dal and vitamins from drumsticks and gourds.

foods.name: Dosa
foods.healthier_alternative: Moong dal chilla (Pesarattu) or Neer dosa prepared with minimal sesame oil or ghee.
foods.reason: Heavily fried restaurant dosas with spicy potato stuffing and sour fermentation can trigger acidity (Pitta). Moong chilla digests much faster.

foods.name: Biryani
foods.healthier_alternative: Home-cooked brown rice or quinoa pulao with mild spices (green cardamom, bay leaf, cinnamon) and lots of fresh veggies.
foods.reason: Excessive red chili, fried onions (birista) and heavy animal fat irritate the stomach lining and cause post-meal lethargy (Tamas).

foods.name: Poha
foods.healthier_alternative: Add extra roasted peanuts, curry leaves, grated ginger, and a generous squeeze of lemon to balance dryness.
foods.reason: Beaten rice is easy to digest. Curry leaves support pancreatic enzymes and ginger kindles digestive fire (Deepana).

foods.name: Maggi Noodles
foods.healthier_alternative: Millet or whole-wheat vermicelli (semiya upma) with peas, carrots, ginger, and homemade curry powder.
foods.reason: Fried maida cakes laden with palm oil, high sodium, and flavor enhancers (INS 627/631) clog bodily channels (Srotas) and trigger sluggishness.

foods.name: Pav Bhaji
foods.healthier_alternative: Whole-wheat toasted pav with mixed vegetable mash (pumpkin, cauliflower, carrots, peas) made with pure ghee and no synthetic food coloring.
foods.reason: Commercial pav contains potassium bromate/maida, and the bhaji typically uses excessive butter and harsh garam masala that provokes Pitta.

foods.name: Palak Paneer
foods.healthier_alternative: Cook spinach with tofu or light homemade cow-milk paneer; add garlic, ginger and pinch of black pepper to lighten digestion.
foods.reason: Spinach is rich in chlorophyll and cooling for Pitta, while paneer supplies protein. Black pepper is essential to avoid Kapha accumulation.

foods.name: Rajma Chawal
foods.healthier_alternative: Soak kidney beans overnight with a pinch of baking soda, boil with ginger and hing (asafoetida), and pair with jeera rice.
foods.reason: Kidney beans have tough skins and complex oligosaccharides that cause gas (Vata). Ginger and hing neutralize vata-aggravating flatulence.

foods.name: Upma
foods.healthier_alternative: Dalia (cracked wheat) or quinoa upma with carrots, beans, curry leaves and roasted mustard seeds.
foods.reason: Warm semolina cooked with ghee and spices is deeply grounding for Vata and stabilizes blood glucose throughout the morning.

foods.name: Curd Rice
foods.healthier_alternative: Use fresh, sweet homemade curd (not sour) tempered with ginger, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Avoid eating after sunset.
foods.reason: Fresh curd rice cools burning digestive sensations in Pitta. Ayurveda cautions against eating curd at night as it blocks micro-channels.

foods.name: Chai with Parle-G
foods.healthier_alternative: Ginger-cardamom herbal tea or golden milk sweetened with jaggery, paired with roasted makhana (foxnuts) or soaked almonds.
foods.reason: Refined sugar, empty carbohydrates, and excess black tea caffeine create rapid blood sugar spikes followed by crashes that destabilize Vata.

foods.name: Pakora
foods.healthier_alternative: Tawa-roasted spiced besan chilla strips or roasted air-fried vegetable fritters with mint-amla dip.
foods.reason: Reheated cooking oils produce oxidative stress and aggravate Rakta (blood tissue) and Pitta, triggering skin breakouts and acid reflux.

foods.name: Dal Tadka
foods.healthier_alternative: Temper with pure cow ghee, cumin, garlic, and turmeric for maximum bio-availability of protein.
foods.reason: Easily digestible plant protein that balances all bodily tissues (Dhatus) when tempered with anti-inflammatory spices.

foods.name: Bhelpuri
foods.healthier_alternative: Sprouted moong chaat with chopped cucumbers, pomegranate, roasted cumin, and mint water (Pani Puri style).
foods.reason: Puffed rice and dry sev increase Vata dryness in the colon, while sour tamarind paste increases Pitta heat.

foods.name: Vada Pav
foods.healthier_alternative: Pan-seared spiced potato-oat patty tucked in whole-grain bun with fresh green garlic-coriander chutney.
foods.reason: Combination of deep-fried starch with white bread creates an intense glycemic load and slows metabolic rate.

foods.name: Gulab Jamun
foods.healthier_alternative: Steamed Sandesh or date-and-fig ladoos (Khajoor roll) rolled in crushed pistachios.
foods.reason: Deep fried milk solids soaked in refined sugar syrup cause immediate insulin spikes and create heavy Ama in the lymphatic system.

packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Sticky (Pichhila), heavy (Guru), causes severe constipation and blocks the micro-channels (Srotas).
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Whole wheat, ragi, jowar, or oats.

packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Extremely heavy to metabolize; aggravates Kapha and triggers Vidaha (internal inflammation).
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Cold-pressed mustard oil, sesame oil, or pure cow ghee.

packaged_red_flags.ingredient: High Fructose Corn Syrup / Invert Syrup
packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Unnatural sweet rasa that over-stimulates Kapha and fatty tissue (Meda Dhatu).
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Raw honey, desi khand, or organic jaggery.

packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Hyper-excites the nervous system (Vata) and induces artificial thirst and Pitta irritability.
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Naturally umami spices like roasted cumin, rock salt, and nutritional yeast.

packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Acts as Garavisha (slow chemical toxin) accumulating in the liver (Yakrit).
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Natural colors derived from turmeric, beetroot, and saffron.

packaged_red_flags.ayurvedic_impact: Dampens digestive fire (Mandagni) and disrupts the gut microbiome flora.
packaged_red_flags.better_swap: Natural preservation via rock salt, turmeric, and airtight glass storage.
